title.value: A unifying framework for fairness-aware influence maximization
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Titre: A unifying framework for fairness-aware influence maximization

analysis.description: The paper discusses a framework for addressing fairness in the influence maximization (IM) problem, which involves selecting the most influential nodes in a network while ensuring fair distribution among different groups. The framework employs mixed integer programming to model various fairness constraints and evaluates its effectiveness through extensive experiments.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments to evaluate the proposed framework, indicating an empirical approach.
type.quote: We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate IM methods subject to various fairness measures.

name.justification: The research focuses on influence maximization in social networks, aiming to ensure fair distribution of influence.
name.quote: The problem of selecting a subset of nodes with greatest influence in a graph, commonly known as influence maximization, has been well studied over the past decade.

name.justification: The paper aims to ensure fairness in the influence maximization process, which is a specific aspect of algorithmic fairness.
name.quote: One of these concerns, which surprisingly has only received limited attention so far, is algorithmic bias and fairness.

name.justification: The experiments used 20 synthetic networks that modeled an intervention in the Antelope Valley region.
name.quote: We examined our framework using the 20 synthetic networks that model an obesity prevention intervention in the Antelope Valley region of California [31].
